instrument: Hillsboro Enterprise Zone re-designation, Resolution No. 2558 (April 2017; boundary expanded 2024)
summary: The Enterprise Zone allows a 100% property tax abatement for 3 to 5 years on new buildings and equipment of eligible businesses; the City Manager or designee is Zone Manager and authorizes eligibility administratively. The city states staff have no discretion to deny an application that meets state law and local policy. Facilities in the Hillsboro School District pay a School Support Fee of 15% of the abated tax in years 4 and 5; local agreements are posted 21 days before taking effect.
text: City staff have no discretion to deny an application that meets the standards set forth in state law
